decisions: Use public repositories and a repository-scoped runner on the authorized VPS.
Use the official Codex CLI with a separate ChatGPT login for this consumer.
Use gpt-6-luna with max reasoning for implementation and independent review.
Keep untrusted verification and privileged controllers on GitHub-hosted runners.

Initial live acceptance is authorized for at most three work items across the two public consumers; do not increase model usage without an administrative decision.
Require strict NexKit verification and NexKit review checks from GitHub Actions on main, through a pull request, with no blanket bypass or mandatory human PR review.
Preserve the Python 3.12+ standard-library label HTTP service, its documented behavior, unittest commands and real subprocess TCP E2E.
Use the deterministic local ZIP builder for the authorized v0.1.0-test.1 release scope; an exact human candidate approval is still required.
